name: A Touch of Death (Necromancy (Cenotaph Path), Basic)

system.description: The Necromancer touches a person or object suspected of ghostly influence, sensing whether a ghost has exerted wraithly power upon it or crossed nearby. Success grants a duration of insight: one success reveals ghostly power used in the last turn; two, the last three turns; three, the last hour (also detects a ghost's touch); four, the last day; five, the last week (also detects a nearby ghost's passage). Should the subject currently be possessed, the Necromancer immediately becomes aware of the possessing wraith, gaining a psychic impression sufficient to use Sepulchre Path powers against it. Known only to the Ghiberti family and other masters of the Cenotaph Path.
system.source: Clanbook: Giovanni, Chapter Two: It Runs in the Family
